serviceToken.description: RS256 service token signed by api/jobs (contracts §11.7); verified with SERVICE_TOKEN_PUBLIC_KEYS by kid.

info.description: Private API called only by the .NET `api` and `jobs` services (contracts §6). Every `/internal/v1` call needs `Authorization: Bearer <service token>`: an RS256 JWT (`kid` header) with `iss` sathi-api|sathi-jobs, `aud` ai-service, `sub`, `uh`, `scp` (space-separated scopes), `rscope` (retrieval scope), `rid`, `iat`, `exp`. Also send `traceparent`, `X-Request-Id` and `X-Run-Id`. Errors are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails.
